title: spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md:122 - Schnorr48 Ed25519 conflation
description: Section 2a.5.1 says 'Schnorr48 Ed25519 signature' but these are different signature schemes. Schnorr48 is the LICHEN-specific scheme (per draft-lichen-schnorr-00), not Ed25519. This naming conflation could cause implementers to use the wrong algorithm. Should say just 'Schnorr48 signature'.
close_reason: Fixed: removed 'Ed25519' conflation from Schnorr48 signature reference in section 2a.5.1
